title: Mold Remediation Price Schedule: Containment and Equipment Days
content:
Mold Remediation containment and equipment are priced per tier as follows. Containment is poly containment with airlock and zipper door; equipment is rented per unit per billable day.

| Item | Spot | Limited | Standard | Extensive | Attic and Crawlspace | HVAC System |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Poly containment under negative pressure required | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Containment setup, per containment (USD) | 0.00 | 465.00 | 612.00 | 845.00 | 538.00 | 0.00 |
| HEPA air scrubber under negative pressure every remediation day | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| HEPA air scrubber, per unit per billable day (USD) | 78.60 | 78.60 | 78.60 | 72.30 | 78.60 | 78.60 |
| LGR dehumidifier, per unit per billable day (USD) | 95.40 | 95.40 | 95.40 | 87.80 | 95.40 | 95.40 |
| Billable equipment day cap (calendar days) | 2 | 3 | 4 | 6 | 4 | 3 |

### Item definitions

| Item | Definition |
|---|---|
| Containment required | Whether poly containment under negative pressure is required on the tier |
| Containment setup | Poly containment with airlock and zipper door, priced per containment |
| Negative air required | Whether a HEPA air scrubber must run under negative pressure for every remediation day |
| HEPA air scrubber | HEPA air scrubber or negative air machine, per unit per billable day |
| LGR dehumidifier | LGR dehumidifier, per unit per billable day while the containment is held |
| Billable equipment day cap | Equipment days billable per job before re-cleaning, counted in calendar days |

### Notes on the schedule

- Spot Mold Remediation and HVAC System Mold Remediation carry No in the containment row and a containment setup price of 0.00. HVAC System Mold Remediation still carries Yes in the negative air row.
- Extensive Mold Remediation carries the lower daily rates of 72.30 for an air scrubber and 87.80 for a dehumidifier; every other tier carries 78.60 and 95.40.
- The billable equipment day cap runs from 2 calendar days on Spot Mold Remediation to 6 on Extensive Mold Remediation.
